title: Endogenous syndicate formation in (rent-seeking) contests
title_zh: （寻租）竞赛中的内生辛迪加形成
title_primary: （寻租）竞赛中的内生辛迪加形成
title_secondary: Endogenous syndicate formation in (rent-seeking) contests
authors: Kyung Hwan Baik, Dongwoo Lee
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study a (rent-seeking) contest in which some players form syndicates and compete collectively, while others compete individually, to win a prize (or rent). A syndicate competes, as a single entity, with the other contestants to win the prize. The organizer of a syndicate chooses the syndicate’s effort level. The members of a syndicate share both the cost of effort and the prize (if it wins), according to the syndicate’s sharing rule. We first examine the profitability of being a syndicate member, assuming that the sizes of the syndicates are exogenously given. Then we consider the endogenous formation of syndicates and its effect on prize (or rent) dissipation. We show that, for any given number of players, there is a unique equilibrium size for the syndicate when only one syndicate is formed, and unique equilibrium sizes of the syndicates when two syndicates are formed. We also show that the endogenous formation of syndicates is beneficial both to the syndicate members and to the singletons, and the endogenous formation of syndicates reduces prize dissipation, compared with the individual (rent-seeking) contest.
abstract_zh: 我们研究一种（寻租）竞赛，其中部分参与者组成辛迪加并集体竞争，而其他参与者则单独竞争，以赢得奖品（或租金）。一个辛迪加作为一个整体与其他参赛者竞争以赢得奖品。辛迪加的组织者选择该辛迪加的努力水平。辛迪加成员根据其分配规则，共同分担努力成本和奖品（若获胜）。我们首先考察成为辛迪加成员的盈利性，假设辛迪加的规模是外生给定的。随后，我们考虑辛迪加的内生形成及其对奖品（或租金）耗散的影响。我们证明，对于任意给定的参与者数量，当仅形成一个辛迪加时，存在唯一的均衡规模；当形成两个辛迪加时，存在唯一的均衡规模。我们还表明，辛迪加的内生形成对辛迪加成员和独立参与者均有益，并且与个人（寻租）竞赛相比，辛迪加的内生形成减少了奖品耗散。

title: Robust inference for time varying predictability: A Sieve-IVX approach
title_zh: 时变可预测性的稳健推断：一种Sieve-IVX方法
title_primary: 时变可预测性的稳健推断：一种Sieve-IVX方法
title_secondary: Robust inference for time varying predictability: A Sieve-IVX approach
authors: Nan Liu, Yanbo Liu, Peter C.B. Phillips, Yajie Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Predictive regression models are often used to evaluate the predictive capability of economic fundamentals on bond and equity returns. Inferential procedures in these regressions typically employ parameter constancy or piecewise constancy in slope coefficients. Such formulations are prone to misspecification, more especially during periods of disturbance or evolution in prevailing economic and financial conditions, which can lead to size distortion and spurious evidence of predictability. To address these issues the present work proposes a semiparametric predictive regression model with mixed-root regressors and time-varying coefficients that allow for smooth evolution in the generating mechanism over time. For estimation and inference a novel variant of the self-generated instrument approach called sieve-IVX is introduced, giving a robust approach to inference concerning time-varying predictability that is applicable irrespective of the degrees of persistence. Asymptotic theory of the Sieve-IVX approach is based on a new infinite dimensional invariance principle that delivers limit theory for sieve-IVX estimation, validating pointwise and uniform inference procedures for testing predictability and model specification. Simulations show excellent performance characteristics of the resulting tests in finite samples. An empirical exercise is conducted examining excess S&P 500 returns, applying Sieve-IVX regression with pointwise and uniform tests to reveal evidence of time-varying patterns in the predictive capability of commonly used fundamental variables.
abstract_zh: 预测性回归模型常被用于评估经济基本面因素对债券和股票收益的预测能力。在这些回归中，推断程序通常假设斜率系数恒定或分段恒定。这种设定容易产生模型误设，尤其是在经济金融状况动荡或演变的时期，可能导致检验规模失真及虚假的预测性证据。为解决这些问题，本研究提出了一种半参数预测性回归模型，该模型包含混合根回归因子及随时间平滑演变的时变系数。在估计与推断方面，引入了一种新颖的自生成工具变量变体，称为sieve-IVX，为时变预测性的推断提供了稳健方法，且适用于各种持久性程度。Sieve-IVX方法的渐近理论基于一个新的无限维不变原理，该原理为sieve-IVX估计提供了极限理论，验证了点态与均匀推断程序在检验预测性和模型设定方面的有效性。模拟结果显示，所提出的检验在有限样本中具有优异的性能特征。本文还进行了实证分析，考察了标准普尔500指数的超额收益，应用Sieve-IVX回归及点态与均匀检验，揭示了常用基本面变量预测能力中的时变模式证据。

title: Does happiness spread within organizations? Evidence from a field experiment in Norway
title_zh: 幸福感会在组织内部传播吗？来自挪威实地实验的证据
title_primary: 幸福感会在组织内部传播吗？来自挪威实地实验的证据
title_secondary: Does happiness spread within organizations? Evidence from a field experiment in Norway
authors: Torbjørn Hanson, Åshild A. Johnsen, Andreas Kotsadam, Alberto Prati
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We report the results from a large field experiment that tests if happiness spreads within an organizational setting, as predicted by the emotional contagion hypothesis. Although some studies have supported this hypothesis, no well-powered randomized controlled trial has ever tested it in the field. In collaboration with the Norwegian Armed Forces, we randomly assign over 1500 recruits to rooms during eight-week boot camps. Some recruits live with relatively happier peers while others live with relatively unhappier ones. We find no evidence of happiness convergence at the room level and reject even small contagion effects. We show that the null result is not explained by excessive stability in happiness, and prior studies in the same setting show that peer effects emerge for some non-emotional attitudes. These results call for a reconsideration of the presumed ubiquity of happiness spillovers, with subsequent implications for well-being models and policies.
abstract_zh: 我们报告了一项大规模实地实验的结果，该实验检验了情绪传染假说所预测的幸福感是否能在组织环境中传播。尽管已有一些研究支持这一假说，但尚无一项具有充分统计功效的随机对照试验在实地环境中对其进行验证。我们与挪威武装部队合作，在为期八周的新兵训练营中，将超过1500名新兵随机分配到不同房间。部分新兵与相对更快乐的同伴同住，而另一些则与相对不那么快乐的同伴同住。我们发现，在房间层面没有证据表明幸福感趋于一致，甚至拒绝了微小的传染效应。我们证明，这一零结果并非由幸福感的过度稳定性所解释，且在同一环境下的先前研究表明，同伴效应确实会对某些非情绪态度产生影响。这些结果呼吁重新审视幸福感溢出效应被假定为普遍存在的观点，并对幸福感模型及政策制定具有后续启示。

title: Inflation Uncertainty and Endogenous Planning Horizons
title_zh: 通货膨胀不确定性与内生规划视野
title_primary: 通货膨胀不确定性与内生规划视野
title_secondary: Inflation Uncertainty and Endogenous Planning Horizons
authors: Christopher Gust, Edward Herbst, David López-Salido
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a finite-horizon planning model in which firms choose how far ahead to plan when setting prices. Planning further ahead improves a firm's pricing decision but requires cognitive effort. We derive analytical solutions for a firm's chosen planning horizon and show that large and persistent aggregate demand or supply disturbances induce firms to plan further ahead, making inflation more sensitive to shocks and generating endogenous movements in inflation uncertainty. Quantitatively, we show that the model matches the positive relationship between the size of inflation forecast revisions and inflation uncertainty observed in the data.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个有限期界规划模型，其中企业在设定价格时选择提前规划的时间长度。更远的规划能优化企业的定价决策，但需付出认知努力。我们推导出企业最优规划期界的解析解，并表明大规模且持久的总体需求或供给扰动会促使企业延长规划期，从而使通胀对冲击更为敏感，并引发通胀不确定性的内生变动。在量化层面，我们证明该模型与数据中观察到的通胀预测修正幅度与通胀不确定性之间的正相关关系相吻合。

title: The Distributional Effects of Economic Uncertainty*
title_zh: 经济不确定性的分配效应
title_primary: 经济不确定性的分配效应
title_secondary: The Distributional Effects of Economic Uncertainty*
authors: Florian Huber, Massimiliano Marcellino, Tommaso Tornese
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the distributional implications of uncertainty shocks by developing a model that links macroeconomic aggregates to the US distribution of earnings and consumption. Our findings suggest that the fraction of low‐earning workers decreases initially, while the share of households reporting low consumption increases. At longer horizons, the fraction of low‐income workers increases, but the consumption distribution reverts to its preshock shape. While the first phase reduces income inequality and increases consumption inequality, in the second stage income inequality rises, and the effects on consumption inequality dissipate.
abstract_zh: 我们通过构建一个将宏观经济总量与美国收入与消费分布联系起来的模型，研究不确定性冲击的分配效应。研究结果表明，低收入工人比例初期下降，而报告低消费的家庭比例上升。在较长时期内，低收入工人比例增加，但消费分布恢复至冲击前形态。第一阶段降低了收入不平等并加剧了消费不平等，而第二阶段收入不平等上升，对消费不平等的影响则逐渐消散。

title: Deliberate stochastic choice: A mouse-tracking experiment
title_zh: 审慎随机选择：一项鼠标追踪实验
title_primary: 审慎随机选择：一项鼠标追踪实验
title_secondary: Deliberate stochastic choice: A mouse-tracking experiment
authors: Mattia Adamo, Giorgio Coricelli
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Stochastic choice (SC)—the tendency to select different options across repeated presentations of the same choice set—is well documented, yet its cognitive mechanisms remain debated. We combine mouse-tracking with the experimental design of Agranov and Ortoleva (2017), comparing distant and sequential repetitions of lottery choices. We show that the Area Under the Curve (AUC) provides a more informative process-level measure of SC than response times (RT). RT decline after the first presentation in both repetition structures, but do not reliably predict trial-level switching. AUC remains stable across distant repetitions while drops sharply after the first sequential choice, suggesting that explicit repetitions allow participants to plan subsequent choices at first and execute them more directly thereafter. AUC also reveals heterogeneity hidden by aggregate choice data: among regular participants, SC does not increase AUC in distant repeats, but produces larger and more curved trajectories in sequential repeats, suggesting a signature of cautiousness under explicit randomization. Among dominance violators, SC is instead accompanied by larger and more erratic trajectories, suggesting error-driven variability. Overall, SC appears to combine a predominantly deliberate component with a smaller boundedly rational component.
abstract_zh: 随机选择（SC）——即在面对相同选择集的重复呈现时倾向于选择不同选项——已被充分记录，但其认知机制仍存在争议。我们将鼠标追踪与Agranov和Ortoleva（2017）的实验设计相结合，比较了彩票选择的远距离重复与顺序重复。我们表明，曲线下面积（AUC）比反应时间（RT）提供了更具信息量的过程层面SC度量。在两种重复结构中，RT在首次呈现后均有所下降，但并不能可靠预测试验层面的切换行为。AUC在远距离重复中保持稳定，而在首次顺序选择后急剧下降，这表明明确的重复使参与者能够在首次时规划后续选择，并在之后更直接地执行。AUC还揭示了聚合选择数据所隐藏的异质性：在常规参与者中，SC在远距离重复中并未增加AUC，但在顺序重复中产生了更大且更弯曲的轨迹，这表明在明确随机化下存在谨慎性的特征。在优势违反者中，SC反而伴随着更大且更不稳定的轨迹，表明存在错误驱动的变异性。总体而言，SC似乎结合了以深思熟虑成分为主与较小程度的有界理性成分。

title: Stepping stone or stumbling block: the impact of tax incentives on corporate artificial intelligence adoption
title_zh: 垫脚石还是绊脚石：税收激励对企业人工智能采纳的影响
title_primary: 垫脚石还是绊脚石：税收激励对企业人工智能采纳的影响
title_secondary: Stepping stone or stumbling block: the impact of tax incentives on corporate artificial intelligence adoption
authors: Jingsong Zhu, Xiaohan Liang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Accelerated depreciation policies allow firms to front-load depreciation allowances, generating a substantial intertemporal tax shield that reduces the cost of capital. Leveraging China’s 2014 accelerated depreciation policy for fixed assets as a quasi-natural experiment, this study employs a Difference-in-Differences (DID) method to examine its impact on corporate artificial intelligence (AI) adoption. Our results indicate that the tax incentive serves as a ‘stepping stone’, significantly promoting the uptake of AI technologies in pilot firms. This positive outcome primarily operates through two taxpayer-side mechanisms: alleviating financing constraints and upgrading human capital structures. Shifting the focus from taxpayers to tax administration, moderation analysis distinguishes between administrative services and administrative enforcement by revealing that policy effectiveness is strengthened by streamlined services rather than stringent enforcement. Heterogeneity analysis further demonstrates that the AI-promoting effect is more pronounced for large-scale or recession-stage firms, as well as those in low-uncertainty environments. Finally, we bridge the gap between tax incentives and market stability by showing that the tax incentive suppresses stock price crash risk, revealing its crucial role in fortifying firm resilience and mitigating financial risks. This study provides empirical evidence on how targeted tax incentives catalyse corporate AI adoption, offering policy implications for facilitating high-quality economic development. KEYWORDS: Accelerated depreciation policy for fixed assets corporate artificial intelligence adoption tax incentive financing constraints human capital structures JEL CLASSIFICATION: O33 O38 H25 H32
abstract_zh: 加速折旧政策允许企业提前计提折旧，形成跨期税盾，从而降低资本成本。本研究以中国2014年固定资产加速折旧政策为准自然实验，采用双重差分法（DID）考察其对企业人工智能（AI）采纳的影响。结果表明，税收激励作为“垫脚石”，显著促进了试点企业AI技术的应用。这一积极效应主要通过两条纳税人侧机制实现：缓解融资约束与升级人力资本结构。将视角从纳税人转向税收征管，调节效应分析区分了行政服务与行政执行，发现政策有效性通过简化服务而非严格执法得以增强。异质性分析进一步表明，大规模企业、衰退期企业以及处于低不确定性环境中的企业，其AI促进效应更为显著。最后，本研究通过揭示税收激励抑制股价崩盘风险，弥合了税收激励与市场稳定性之间的研究缺口，凸显其在增强企业韧性与化解金融风险中的关键作用。本研究为定向税收激励如何催化企业AI采纳提供了经验证据，并为推动经济高质量发展提供了政策启示。关键词：固定资产加速折旧政策；企业人工智能采纳；税收激励；融资约束；人力资本结构 JEL分类：O33 O38 H25 H32

title: DP155 Myopia, the 'Dividend Puzzle', and Share Prices
title_zh: 近视、‘股息之谜’与股票价格
title_primary: 近视、‘股息之谜’与股票价格
title_secondary: DP155 Myopia, the 'Dividend Puzzle', and Share Prices
authors: Stephen Nickell, Sushil Wadhwani, William Quinn, John Turner, Clive Walker 等
official: 官方在线 1987-02-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper, we report econometric evidence suggesting that the market attaches too high a weight to current dividends relative to future dividends. This is consistent with the widely-held belief that the market is myopic. The main reason that we obtain a different result is that we estimate a model that is more general than the standard approach. However, we find no evidence to link this myopic behaviour with increased institutional ownership of equity. Our evidence can also be interpreted as a rejection of the standard efficient markets model, even when we allow for a time-varying discount rate. In addition our test does not depend on the time-series properties of dividends (e.g. we do not require stationarity).
abstract_zh: 本文报告了计量经济学证据，表明市场对当前股息的权重过高，而对未来股息的权重过低。这与市场普遍存在的短视行为观点一致。我们得出不同结果的主要原因在于，我们估计的模型比标准方法更为一般化。然而，我们未发现证据表明这种短视行为与机构持股比例上升有关。我们的证据也可被解读为对标准有效市场模型的否定，即使我们允许贴现率随时间变化。此外，我们的检验不依赖于股息的时间序列特性（例如，我们不需要平稳性假设）。

title: Information Paths and Learning in Games: Experimental Evidence
title_zh: 信息路径与博弈中的学习：实验证据
title_primary: 信息路径与博弈中的学习：实验证据
title_secondary: Information Paths and Learning in Games: Experimental Evidence
authors: Peiran Jiao, H. Nax, Jichuan Zong
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Information in repeated real-world interactions is rarely fixed. Instead, over time, players typically learn more about the game structure, understand more about their own payoff correspondences, and find out what others did and earned in the past. However, how this dynamic information path influences learning and which aggregate outcomes are reached as a result have not been investigated to date. To study this, we conducted a series of laboratory experimental games where we provided more information over time in different orders and along different paths. These games span two strategically distinct classes: a Cournot game with a unique symmetric Nash equilibrium, and step-level public-goods (coordination) games with multiple Nash equilibria of differing Pareto efficiency. Our evidence confirms a natural mapping from information to predominant learning rule: information about own payoffs triggers payoff-based learning, feedback concerning others’ realized payoffs triggers imitation, and structural information about the game triggers best response. In addition, when multiple learning rules are feasible, which one dominates depends on information paths. In particular, feedback about others’ actions and payoffs, especially when supplied marginally, may trigger persistent imitation that locks into Pareto-inferior Nash equilibria, even when more information later becomes available.
abstract_zh: 在重复的真实世界互动中，信息很少是固定不变的。相反，随着时间的推移，参与者通常会更多地了解博弈结构，更深入地理解自身的收益对应关系，并获知他人过去的行动与所得。然而，这种动态信息路径如何影响学习过程，以及最终会达到哪些总体结果，至今尚未得到研究。为探究此问题，我们开展了一系列实验室实验博弈，在不同顺序和不同路径下随时间逐步提供更多信息。这些博弈涵盖两个策略上截然不同的类别：具有唯一对称纳什均衡的古诺博弈，以及具有多个帕累托效率不同的纳什均衡的阶梯式公共品（协调）博弈。我们的证据证实了信息与主导学习规则之间的自然对应关系：关于自身收益的信息触发基于收益的学习，关于他人已实现收益的反馈触发模仿，而关于博弈结构的信息则触发最优反应。此外，当多种学习规则均可行时，哪一种占据主导取决于信息路径。特别是，关于他人行动和收益的反馈，尤其是以边际方式提供时，可能触发持续模仿，从而锁定在帕累托较劣的纳什均衡中，即使后续有更多信息可用也是如此。

title: Ambiguity vs. Risk in Investment Decisions: A Continuous Decomposition
title_zh: 投资决策中的模糊性与风险：一种连续分解
title_primary: 投资决策中的模糊性与风险：一种连续分解
title_secondary: Ambiguity vs. Risk in Investment Decisions: A Continuous Decomposition
authors: Geoffrey Heal, Marcella Lucchetta
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides a novel framework for assessing the effect of ambiguity on asset values within the Klibanoff-Marinacci-Mukerji (KMM) smooth ambiguity framework. By shifting the analysis into a continuous space of prior probabilities, we establish that ambiguity leads to an adjustment of beliefs (“ambiguity-adjusted probabilities” or “distorted probabilities”) characterized by First-Order Stochastic Dominance (FSD). Leveraging this property, we introduce a systematic economic decomposition of asset valuation separating the baseline risky valuation from the structural cost of uncertainty. Our continuous framework shows that increased ambiguity aversion depresses optimal asset demand.
abstract_zh: 本文在Klibanoff-Marinacci-Mukerji（KMM）平滑模糊性框架内，提出了一种评估模糊性对资产价值影响的新框架。通过将分析转换到先验概率的连续空间，我们证实模糊性会导致信念调整（即“模糊性调整概率”或“扭曲概率”），其特征由一阶随机占优（FSD）刻画。利用这一性质，我们引入了一种系统性的资产估值经济分解方法，将基准风险估值与不确定性的结构性成本分离开来。我们的连续框架表明，模糊性厌恶程度的增强会抑制最优资产需求。

title: Opioid Use, Mortality Risks and Crime: Insights from a Rapid Reduction in Heroin Supply

authors: Timothy J. Moore, Kevin T. Schnepel
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In 2001 a large and sustained supply shock halted a heroin epidemic in Australia. We use drug offenses to identify individual opioid users and examine how the shock affected their mortality risks and criminal activity over the next eight years. Initially, gains from fewer overdoses are offset by drug substitution and more crime, including homicides. Most adverse effects dissipate over time, whereas persistent mortality reductions save the lives of around one in 48 individuals in our sample. Our results demonstrate that reducing the supply of illicit opioids can lead to meaningful longer-term improvements, even when the short-term effects are ambiguous.
abstract_zh: 2001年，一场大规模且持续的供给冲击终结了澳大利亚的海洛因流行。我们利用毒品犯罪数据识别个体阿片类药物使用者，并考察了该冲击如何影响他们在随后八年间的死亡风险与犯罪活动。最初，过量用药减少带来的收益被药物替代及更多犯罪（包括凶杀案）所抵消。大多数不利影响随时间消散，而持续性的死亡率降低则挽救了样本中约每48人中的1条生命。我们的结果表明，即使短期效果尚不明确，减少非法阿片类药物的供给仍能带来有意义的长期改善。

title: Designing Dynamic Reassignment Mechanisms: Evidence from GP Allocation
title_zh: 设计动态再分配机制：来自全科医生分配的实证证据
title_primary: 设计动态再分配机制：来自全科医生分配的实证证据
title_secondary: Designing Dynamic Reassignment Mechanisms: Evidence from GP Allocation
authors: Huitfeldt, Ingrid, Marone, Victoria, Waldinger, Daniel
official: 卷期日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the problem of designing a dynamic reassignment mechanism when agents’ preferences over objects change over time. In the context of Norway’s system for (re)assigning patients to general practitioners (GPs), we provide direct evidence of misallocation under the current mechanism—patients waiting for each others’ GPs, but who cannot trade—and estimate a structural model of GP switching behavior to evaluate alternatives. Introducing Top Trading Cycles (TTC) would, on average, reduce waiting times and increase patient welfare. However, patients endowed with less desirable GPs would be harmed. Prioritizing these patients can avoid these harms while preserving most of the gains from TTC.
abstract_zh: 本文研究当主体对对象的偏好随时间变化时，如何设计动态再分配机制。以挪威全科医生（GP）患者（重新）分配系统为背景，我们提供了当前机制下资源错配的直接证据——患者相互等待对方的全科医生却无法进行交换——并估计了全科医生转换行为的结构模型以评估替代方案。引入顶级交易循环（TTC）机制平均而言将缩短等待时间并提高患者福利。然而，被分配到较不理想全科医生的患者将受到损害。优先考虑这些患者可以避免此类损害，同时保留TTC机制的大部分收益。

title: Divergent Perceptions, Divergent Pay: Inflation and the Gender Wage Gap
title_zh: 分歧认知，分歧薪酬：通货膨胀与性别工资差距
title_primary: 分歧认知，分歧薪酬：通货膨胀与性别工资差距
title_secondary: Divergent Perceptions, Divergent Pay: Inflation and the Gender Wage Gap
authors: Lovisa Reiche & Nicolò Maffei-Faccioli
official: 官方在线 2026-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Inflationary shocks do not affect all workers equally. Comparing men and women, we document two facts. First, both demand- and supply-driven inflationary shocks widen the gender wage gap within industries and occupations. Because these shocks imply opposite business-cycle conditions, their common effect points to inflation as the relevant force. Second, women and men perceive the same inflationary shocks as having different labor-market consequences: women expect conditions to worsen, while men expect them to improve. This asymmetry creates an expectations channel linking inflation to unequal wage growth. We formalize this channel in a New Keynesian search-and-matching model with male and female workers, imperfect information, and gender-specific ambiguity attitudes. Common macroeconomic signals lead ambiguity-averse women to place greater weight on adverse supply-driven states. For inflationary signals, this lowers their perceived outside options and wage demands relative to men
abstract_zh: 通胀冲击对不同劳动者的影响并不均等。通过对比男性和女性，我们揭示了两项事实。其一，无论是需求驱动型还是供给驱动型的通胀冲击，都会在行业和职业内部扩大性别工资差距。由于这两类冲击对应截然不同的商业周期条件，其共同效应表明通胀本身才是关键作用力。其二，面对相同的通胀冲击，女性和男性对其劳动力市场后果的感知存在差异：女性预期就业状况将恶化，而男性则预期改善。这种认知不对称形成了一种将通胀与工资不平等增长联系起来的预期传导渠道。我们通过构建包含男女劳动者、不完全信息以及性别特异性模糊态度的新凯恩斯搜寻匹配模型，对这一渠道进行了形式化分析。共同的宏观经济信号使厌恶模糊性的女性更倾向于赋予不利供给驱动状态更高权重。对于通胀信号而言，这导致她们相较于男性降低了对外部选择权与工资诉求的预期值。

title: The Impact of US Sanctions on Food Security: Evidence from a Global Panel
title_zh: 美国制裁对粮食安全的影响：基于全球面板数据的证据
title_primary: 美国制裁对粮食安全的影响：基于全球面板数据的证据
title_secondary: The Impact of US Sanctions on Food Security: Evidence from a Global Panel
authors: Chengjiu Sun, Shanshan Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine the impact of U.S. sanctions on food security using a panel of 185 economies over 1990-2017, linking the World Food Programme (WFP) multidimensional food security indicator system to sanction episodes. Using difference-in-differences identification strategy and an event-study design, we show that sanctions significantly reduce food security in target countries, widening the gap with non-sanctioned countries by about 30 percent. Effects are concentrated in food access and stability-key dimensions of household food affordability and resilience-and are primarily driven by trade and financial restrictions. Mechanism analysis indicates that sanctions operate through both supply and demand channels. On the supply side, they reduce food imports and domestic production. On the demand side, they lower income, raise inflation and unemployment, and weaken political stability. Notably, the sanction impacts are strongest in low- and lower-middle-income countries, where food systems are more vulnerable to external shocks. These results highlight substantial and uneven humanitarian costs of sanctions for food security.
abstract_zh: 我们利用1990-2017年间185个经济体的面板数据，将世界粮食计划署（WFP）多维粮食安全指标系统与制裁事件相关联，考察美国制裁对粮食安全的影响。采用双重差分识别策略和事件研究设计，我们发现制裁显著降低了目标国的粮食安全水平，使其与未受制裁国家的差距扩大约30%。影响主要集中在粮食获取与稳定性——即家庭粮食可负担性与韧性的关键维度——且主要由贸易和金融限制驱动。机制分析表明，制裁通过供给和需求双重渠道发挥作用：在供给端，制裁减少了粮食进口和国内生产；在需求端，制裁降低了收入水平、推高了通胀和失业率，并削弱了政治稳定性。值得注意的是，制裁对低收入和中低收入国家的影响最为显著，这些国家的粮食体系更易受到外部冲击。这些结果揭示了制裁对粮食安全造成的巨大且不均衡的人道主义代价。

title: The forsaken road: Reassessing living standards following the Cuban Revolution and the American embargo
title_zh: 被遗弃之路：重新评估古巴革命与美国禁运后的生活水平
title_primary: 被遗弃之路：重新评估古巴革命与美国禁运后的生活水平
title_secondary: The forsaken road: Reassessing living standards following the Cuban Revolution and the American embargo
authors: João Pedro Bastos, Vincent Geloso, Jamie Bologna Pavlik
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate the causal effects of the 1959 Cuban Revolution on income using a synthetic control approach. We employ a novel dataset with revised GDP estimates that do not rely on the regime’s self-reported statistics. We also analyze GDP estimates net of aid coming from the Soviet Union. Our identification strategy allows us to separate the direct effects of the revolution from the diplomatic events that ensued. By overcoming concerns that Cuban GDP statistics are inflated either by the regime’s direct manipulation or by Soviet aid, we identify a large decline in Cuban GDP per capita relative to its counterfactual. The decline is larger when accounting for Soviet aid. The embargo only accounts for a minor share of Cuba’s under-performance relative to the counterfactual. Our results hold after being subjected to multiple robustness checks and lead to the conclusion that the transition to socialism was the main driver of the inferior economic path Cuba has followed since 1959.
abstract_zh: 我们采用合成控制法，探究1959年古巴革命对收入的因果效应。我们使用了一套新颖的数据集，其中包含不依赖政权自报统计的修订后GDP估算。同时，我们还分析了扣除苏联援助后的GDP估算值。我们的识别策略使我们能够将革命的直接影响与随之而来的外交事件区分开来。通过克服古巴GDP统计可能因政权直接操纵或苏联援助而虚高的担忧，我们发现古巴人均GDP相对于其反事实情景出现了大幅下降。在考虑苏联援助后，这一下降幅度更大。禁运仅解释了古巴相对于反事实表现不佳的一小部分原因。我们的结果在经历多重稳健性检验后依然成立，并得出结论：向社会主义的过渡是古巴自1959年以来经济路径落后的主要驱动力。

title: Success and Failure of a Zero-Interest Green Loan program: Evidence from France
title_zh: 零利率绿色贷款项目的成功与失败：来自法国的证据
title_primary: 零利率绿色贷款项目的成功与失败：来自法国的证据
title_secondary: Success and Failure of a Zero-Interest Green Loan program: Evidence from France
authors: Ilya Eryzhenskiy, Louis-Gaëtan Giraudet, Mariona Segu
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Zero-interest green loan programs (ZIGL) are gaining traction to address the tremendous financing needs implied by net-zero emission targets. We provide the first evaluation of such a program, the \emph{Éco-Prêt à Taux Zéro}, introduced in France in 2009 to encourage home energy retrofits. Using an event-study design applied to a panel survey of 10,000 households, we find evidence that the program had a substantial, yet short-lived, effect. Eligibility to the program increased investment by 20-22\% on the extensive margin and 2-3\% on the intensive one, thereby generating 3\% electricity savings. The effects are however limited to the first two years, after which they turn non-significant. They are primarily driven by low-income homeowners, suggesting the program effectively alleviates credit constraints. These results are robust to a range of robustness checks, including placebo regressions and propensity score weighting. They lead to leverage estimates in the 1.3-1.7 range in the `successful' period and below 1 thereafter. Using additional banking data to investigate the post-2011 failure, we find suggestive evidence that banks exploited prospective borrowers’ incomplete information to sell them their own loan products in lieu of a ZIGL.
abstract_zh: 零利率绿色贷款项目（ZIGL）正日益受到关注，以应对净零排放目标所隐含的巨大融资需求。我们首次对此类项目进行了评估，即法国于2009年推出的“零利率生态贷款”（Éco-Prêt à Taux Zéro），旨在鼓励家庭能源改造。通过将事件研究设计应用于一项涵盖10,000户家庭的面板调查，我们发现证据表明该项目产生了显著但短暂的效果。符合资格条件使投资在广泛边际上增加了20-22%，在集约边际上增加了2-3%，从而实现了3%的电力节约。然而，这些效应仅限于前两年，之后变得不再显著。这些效应主要由低收入房主驱动，表明该项目有效缓解了信贷约束。这些结果在一系列稳健性检验中保持稳健，包括安慰剂回归和倾向得分加权。在“成功”期间，杠杆估计值在1.3-1.7范围内，此后降至1以下。利用额外的银行数据调查2011年后的失效现象，我们发现了暗示性证据，表明银行利用潜在借款人的信息不完全，向其推销自有贷款产品以替代ZIGL。

title: Defaults harmonize our food choices – a systematic data review of default effects across socio-demographic groups
title_zh: 默认选项协调我们的食物选择——跨社会人口群体的默认效应系统数据综述
title_primary: 默认选项协调我们的食物选择——跨社会人口群体的默认效应系统数据综述
title_secondary: Defaults harmonize our food choices – a systematic data review of default effects across socio-demographic groups
authors: Dominic Lemken, Aline Simonetti, Sanchayan Banerjee, Paul Lohmann
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Food policy often struggles to reach diverse population groups, and well-intentioned interventions can sometimes exacerbate inequalities along socio-demographic groups. This systematic data review examines whether default nudges in food choices have consistent effects across different socio-demographic groups, or whether their impact varies depending on factors such as education level, age, and gender. After selecting eligible studies, authors from 12 studies shared their primary data and were subsequently included in the Default Nudge Research & Data Sharing Consortium (Table A2). These primary data enabled us to analyze 40 interaction effects examining whether age, gender, and education moderate the effectiveness of defaults relative to active choice conditions. Results show no consistent and rarely any interaction effects, suggesting defaults influence food decisions similarly across socio-demographic groups. A possible exception is that harmful defaults may be more effective among less educated individuals. These findings highlight default nudges as a broadly equitable behavioral tool in food policy design.
abstract_zh: 食品政策往往难以覆盖多样化的人群，而意图良好的干预措施有时可能会加剧不同社会人口群体之间的不平等。本系统数据综述旨在探讨食品选择中的默认助推是否在不同社会人口群体间具有一致的效果，还是其影响会因教育水平、年龄和性别等因素而异。在筛选出符合条件的研究后，来自12项研究的作者分享了他们的原始数据，并随后被纳入默认助推研究与数据共享联盟（表A2）。这些原始数据使我们能够分析40个交互效应，以检验年龄、性别和教育是否调节默认选项相对于主动选择条件的有效性。结果显示，交互效应并不一致且极少出现，表明默认选项对社会人口群体的食品决策影响相似。一个可能的例外是，有害默认选项可能在教育程度较低的个体中更为有效。这些发现凸显了默认助推作为食品政策设计中一种广泛公平的行为工具。

title: Employment allocations and unemployment: The role of international trade and migration frictions
title_zh: 就业配置与失业：国际贸易与移民摩擦的作用
title_primary: 就业配置与失业：国际贸易与移民摩擦的作用

authors: Xin Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-05-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Understanding the drivers of structural change has long been a central objective in development economics. While quantitative models that integrate multiple mechanisms into a unified framework offer valuable insights into their relative importance, this paper offers an alternative empirical perspective by highlighting and comparing the distinct impacts that different mechanisms have on other dimensions of labour market outcomes. Specifically, it examines two key forces behind labour reallocation out of agriculture: international trade and reductions in intersectoral allocation frictions. The paper shows, both theoretically and empirically, that these forces have opposite effects on unemployment. It further emphasizes that the reallocation of market shares toward more productive firms is a crucial mechanism behind the impact of trade.
abstract_zh: 摘要 理解结构变迁的驱动因素一直是发展经济学的核心目标。尽管将多种机制整合到统一框架中的定量模型为其相对重要性提供了宝贵见解，但本文提供了一种替代性的实证视角，通过强调并比较不同机制对劳动力市场其他维度结果的独特影响。具体而言，本文考察了劳动力从农业部门转移的两大关键力量：国际贸易和部门间配置摩擦的减少。本文在理论和实证层面均表明，这两种力量对失业具有相反的影响。此外，本文强调，市场份额向更具生产率的企业重新配置是贸易影响背后的关键机制。

title: The role of executives in foreign tax planning
title_zh: 高管在海外税务筹划中的作用
title_primary: 高管在海外税务筹划中的作用
title_secondary: The role of executives in foreign tax planning
authors: Benjamin Osswald, Jochen Pierk
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates the importance of top executives for foreign tax planning in multinational corporations. Applying incremental R2 comparisons and Shapley Value decompositions, we find that executives account for meaningful variation in foreign tax planning and the number of foreign (tax haven) subsidiaries, but have limited influence on effective tax rates in nonhaven affiliates. We further provide initial evidence that executive influence declined following the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 (TCJA), with the decrease being less pronounced for foreign effective tax rates than for domestic ones. Overall, our findings highlight how managers' influence varies with their firms’ internal structures and external policy changes. Our results contribute to the literature on executive effects, multinational tax planning, and the behavioral implications of tax policy reforms.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了跨国公司高层管理人员在海外税务筹划中的重要性。通过采用增量R²比较和Shapley值分解方法，我们发现高管对海外税务筹划及海外（避税天堂）子公司数量的变化具有显著影响，但对非避税天堂附属公司的有效税率影响有限。我们进一步提供了初步证据表明，2017年《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）实施后，高管影响力有所下降，且这一下降幅度在海外有效税率上不如国内有效税率显著。总体而言，我们的研究结果凸显了管理者影响力如何随企业内部结构和外部政策变化而调整。我们的研究为高管效应、跨国税务筹划及税收政策改革的行为影响等相关文献做出了贡献。

official: 官方在线 2025-12-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Empirical models of trade agreements implicitly assume that withdrawal from a trade agreement has an equal and opposite trade effect as accession (i.e., symmetry). With increasing opposition to international economic cooperation, it becomes urgent to test this assumption. We analyze a quasi-natural experiment to explicitly test the symmetry assumption in the context of the termination of a free trade agreement (FTA) using the gravity model. In 2004, Estonia joined the European Union, which mandated that it withdraw from its FTA with Ukraine. Carefully controlling for possible confounding effects of European Union enlargement using a variety of methods, we isolate the FTA withdrawal effect and find strong support in favour of symmetry. Moreover, while import tariffs matter, the bulk of the effect comes from non-tariff effects of an FTA. General equilibrium estimates suggest that the FTA withdrawal led to a noticeable welfare loss for members.
abstract_zh: 贸易协定的实证模型隐含地假设，退出贸易协定与加入贸易协定具有相等且相反的贸易效应（即对称性）。随着对国际经济合作的反对日益加剧，检验这一假设变得尤为迫切。我们利用一个准自然实验，通过引力模型明确检验了自由贸易协定（FTA）终止情境下的对称性假设。2004年，爱沙尼亚加入欧盟，这要求其退出与乌克兰之间的自由贸易协定。通过多种方法仔细控制欧盟扩大的潜在混淆效应，我们分离出自由贸易协定退出的效应，并发现强烈支持对称性的证据。此外，尽管进口关税具有重要性，但大部分效应源自自由贸易协定的非关税影响。一般均衡估计表明，自由贸易协定的退出给成员国带来了显著的福利损失。

title: Firm-level perception of climate policy uncertainty and resilience: textual evidence from China’s A-share market

title_secondary: Firm-level perception of climate policy uncertainty and resilience: textual evidence from China’s A-share market
authors: Longyue Liang, Weiwei Yang, Yitao Zhang
official: 官方在线 2025-09-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In the context of global climate change, the importance of climate policy is increasingly growing. However, individual differences in Perception of Climate Policy Uncertainty (PCPU) often lead to divergent impacts on firm resilience. Therefore, we used textual analysis to construct the firm-level PCPU index and investigated the impact of PCPU on the firm resilience of Chinese listed firms, exploring its potential channels from multiple perspectives. The empirical results indicate that PCPU can promote the green technology innovation and Total Factor Productivity (TFP) of firms, thereby improving their resilience, and ESG performance can effectively enhance the positive effect of PCPU on firm resilience. This impact manifests most prominently in regions with established carbon emission trading systems and phases following the enactment of environmental protection tax law. High risk preference of firm management can weaken the impact. Our study provides empirical evidence on how the PCPU influences firm resilience, which is crucial for firms to enhance climate policy responsiveness and operational capacity.

title: Targeted Trade Policy Instruments and Climate Change Mitigation: The Case of Environmental Provisions in Trade Agreements
title_zh: 定向贸易政策工具与气候变化减缓：贸易协定中环境条款的案例研究
title_primary: 定向贸易政策工具与气候变化减缓：贸易协定中环境条款的案例研究
title_secondary: Targeted Trade Policy Instruments and Climate Change Mitigation: The Case of Environmental Provisions in Trade Agreements
authors: Petros Suzgo Kayovo Mkandawire, Dela‐Dem Doe Fiankor, Bernhard Brümmer
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2025-09-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article examines the effect of including environmental provisions (EPs) in preferential trade agreements (PTAs) on climate change mitigation and explores whether these effects vary based on the heterogeneity of the EPs. Our analysis combines country‐level data on climate change mitigation with details on 300 types of EPs in 775 trade agreements. Empirically, we estimate a generalised method of moments regression and address potential endogeneity using instrumental variables. Our results show that the inclusion of EPs in PTAs significantly improves climate change mitigation, regardless of whether we measure performance using the Climate Change Performance Index, the Environmental Performance Index or CO 2 emissions data. The effectiveness of these provisions, however, depends on their diversity. Key benefits include reduced greenhouse gas emissions, increased renewable energy use, improved energy efficiency and enhanced climate policies. More importantly, PTAs with direct climate provisions yield greater improvements in climate change mitigation outcomes compared to those addressing environmental issues more generally or indirectly. Finally, we show that PTAs with climate change provisions are an effective tool for climate change mitigation, regardless of the development status of the signatories. However, the effects are more pronounced for North–South PTAs.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了优惠贸易协定（PTAs）中纳入环境条款（EPs）对气候变化缓解的影响，并探讨了这些影响是否因环境条款的异质性而有所不同。我们的分析将国家层面的气候变化缓解数据与775个贸易协定中300种环境条款的详细信息相结合。在实证方面，我们采用广义矩估计回归方法，并利用工具变量处理潜在的内生性问题。研究结果表明，无论我们使用气候变化绩效指数、环境绩效指数还是二氧化碳排放数据来衡量绩效，PTAs中纳入环境条款均显著改善了气候变化缓解效果。然而，这些条款的有效性取决于其多样性。主要益处包括减少温室气体排放、增加可再生能源使用、提高能源效率以及强化气候政策。更重要的是，与一般性或间接涉及环境问题的PTAs相比，包含直接气候条款的PTAs在气候变化缓解结果上带来了更大的改善。最后，我们证明，无论签署国的发展状况如何，含有气候变化条款的PTAs都是缓解气候变化的有效工具。然而，对于南北型PTAs，其效果更为显著。

title: Revolving Credit to SMEs: The Role of Business Credit Cards
title_zh: 中小企业循环信贷：商业信用卡的作用
title_primary: 中小企业循环信贷：商业信用卡的作用
title_secondary: Revolving Credit to SMEs: The Role of Business Credit Cards
authors: Matteo Benetton, Greg Buchak, Ritvana Rrukaj, Frode Steen, Jan De Loecker 等
official: 官方在线 2024-12-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Small businesses in the US are frequently excluded from borrowing through traditional term loans or lines of credit and rely instead on highly standardized, high-interest rate business credit cards to meet their financing needs. Are rates high because this credit is costly to provide or because lenders charge high markups? We document that average credit card utilization is almost 30% and is higher for firms facing significant cashflow volatility. While the unconditional delinquency rate is low, it is strongly correlated with utilization, potentially making cards expensive to provide because borrowers make interest-generating draws when they are least able to repay. We develop and estimate a structural model of firms’ card demand, utilization, and default choice, accounting for imperfect competition and the correlation between utilization and default. We find that while the correlation between utilization and delinquency leads to modestly higher rates, they are primarily explained by markups rather than lender costs, making business card provision highly profitable. In counterfactual analyses we show that under systematic stress scenarios, absent large shocks to lender funding costs, lender profits tend to rise in times of borrower stress, as higher revenue from utilization more than offsets increases in delinquency. Finally, we evaluate proposed capital regulations that add a portion of undrawn credit limits to bank risk-weighted assets. Such rules reduce bank credit provision and push some lending outside the regulated banking sector, while modestly reducing firm surplus. Because credit card lending tends to be more profitable in times of stress, such regulations may be counterproductive for bank stability.
abstract_zh: 美国小企业通常难以通过传统定期贷款或信用额度获得融资，转而依赖高度标准化、高利率的商业信用卡满足资金需求。这种高利率究竟源于信贷供给成本高昂，还是贷款方收取了高额加价？我们研究发现，企业信用卡平均使用率接近30%，且现金流波动较大的企业使用率更高。虽然无条件违约率较低，但违约率与使用率高度相关——当借款人最无力偿还时，反而会进行产生利息的透支行为，这可能导致信用卡供给成本高昂。我们构建并估计了包含企业信用卡需求、使用率与违约选择的结构模型，充分考虑了不完全竞争以及使用率与违约之间的相关性。研究发现，虽然使用率与违约率的关联性会适度推高利率，但利率水平主要源于加价而非贷款成本，这使得商业信用卡业务利润丰厚。反事实分析表明，在系统性压力情景下，只要贷款方融资成本未遭受重大冲击，贷款方利润往往会在借款人承压时期上升——因为使用率带来的更高收入足以抵消违约率上升的影响。最后，我们评估了拟议的资本监管规则（将部分未提取信用额度纳入银行风险加权资产）。此类规则会减少银行信贷供给，将部分贷款业务推向受监管银行体系之外，同时适度降低企业剩余。由于信用卡贷款在压力时期往往更具盈利性，此类监管可能对银行稳定性产生反效果。
